title: DevX Enablement: SDK Stabilization & Quickstart Modernization
creator: Aditi Kumar
description: Consolidate and harden SDKs (Python, Typescript) and refresh quickstarts to reduce time-to-first-success for new teams and reduce standard support requests. This initiative focuses on stabilization, coherent UX across language SDKs, and a set of bite-sized quickstarts that map to common Redwood Inference usage patterns (hosted API, Dedicated, Private).
background: Recent analytics show a 24% drop-off between signup and first successful API call. Support data indicates recurring questions around auth, streaming, and model selection. Multiple SDK PRs exist but lack cross-language parity and conformance tests. Quickstarts are fragmented (one-offs in GitHub and Drive) and out-of-date with the latest Console flows.
objectives: Reduce average time-to-first-success by 40% for new signups
Achieve SDK parity for core surfaces (auth, streaming, function calls) across Python and Typescript
Publish 4 canonical quickstarts (Hello API, Streaming chat, Embeddings pipeline, Private/VPC onboarding) with automated smoke tests
Lower Tier-1 support volume for onboarding by 30%
Improve documentation NPS for 'Getting Started' from 3.6 to 4.4
key_results: Create SDK conformance test suite and run in CI for both Python and TS
Merge SDK stabilization PRs: py-sdk#412, ts-sdk#238
Ship 4 quickstarts and link them from Console onboarding flows
Automate quickstart verification in nightly e2e runs
